title: A Verdict for the Letter
author: Rosalind Coldharbour
blurb: Kestrel Eastwick, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
